owner_source.verbatim: have you fixed that so it won't fail when i ask next time to improve something?

normalized_outcome: A future owner request to improve or correct Mission Control must automatically become an active, traceable requirement before the next substantive action. Its literal meaning, observable acceptance boundary, non-satisfying proxies, implementation state, and direct verification evidence must remain visible until the requested behavior is actually demonstrated or explicitly superseded by the owner.
existing_work_reused: NASA bidirectional requirements traceability and requirements verification matrix

required_outcomes.observable: A new Mission Control owner correction is preserved verbatim with a digest before a worker normalizes or delegates it.
The current task records an owner-observable acceptance result and explicit non-satisfying proxies before claiming completion.
The workflow refuses fixed/done when only an explanation, plan, issue, schema, tests, PR, or CI result exists but the requested owner-visible behavior has not been demonstrated.
A later fresh owner improvement request traverses the complete capture-to-live-verification path without the owner repeating the requirement.

non_satisfying_proxies: the requirement is remembered in chat
the requirement appears in an issue
an architecture document explains the desired behavior
a worker says it incorporated the request
the owner is asked to repeat the same requirement
the system explains the prior failure without changing the next action
next_direct_evidence: Use the next fresh owner-requested Mission Control improvement as a live regression: automatically preserve it, create the acceptance/proxy record, execute the change, and show the owner-visible result without requiring Joel to restate the request.
